machine: gb10-quiet (see MACHINES.md; same GB10 hardware as gb10; quiet-conditions protocol per supermartingales/out/glc-baked/sec1/QUIET-PROTOCOL.md)
protocol: 1 flagged warmup + 10 measured repeats per benchmark; serial whole checked-production wall; quiet-load gate: campaign refused unless 1-minute load average <= 4 at start; admitted at 1-minute load average 3.66 (max 1-minute load observed at any sample during the campaign: 3.69); pinned to CPUs 5-9,15-16 (7 cores); nice 19
command: make sec1-quiet-retime SUPERMART_SEC1=<supermart-sec1> — equivalently, from a shell reniced to absolute niceness 19 (renice, not a relative nice -n, so a priority-boosted parent cannot leak in): taskset -c 5-9,15-16 supermart-sec1 retime --experiments <qtsl-experiments> --machine gb10-quiet --lane host --warmups 1 --repeats 10 --max-load-1min 4 --out supermartingales/out/glc-baked/sec1/gb10-quiet-retime/campaign.json --compare supermartingales/out/glc-baked/sec1/incumbents --retain-containers supermartingales/out/glc-baked/sec1/gb10-quiet-retime/containers --pretty
standalone_geolog: not required: every measured row and flagged warmup embeds a clean geolog acceptance receipt and the same benchmark container SHA
progress: runner monitor emitted progress once per second
receipt: campaign.json (produce-host.json is its byte-identical published twin)
